youtube-transcript.description: Premium YouTube transcript API for AI agents. Extract clean transcript, captions or subtitles from any YouTube URL or video ID. Choose manual or auto-generated captions, select language, optionally translate, and return JSON, plain text or SRT with timestamps for RAG, research, summarization and automation. Payment settles only after a successful response.

url.description: YouTube video URL for transcript, captions, subtitles or video-to-text extraction.

sourcePreference.description: Caption source: any, manual, or generated.

translateTo.description: Optional target language code for YouTube caption translation.

format.description: Output format: json, text or srt.

youtube-transcript-basic.description: Budget YouTube transcript text API for AI agents. Convert a YouTube URL or video ID into clean plain transcript text at a low x402 price. Designed for price-sensitive agents, quick LLM context, indexing, search, RAG pre-processing and bulk automation. For timestamps, SRT, translation and caption-source controls use youtube-transcript.

youtube-transcribe.description: YouTube transcribe API alias for AI agents. Transcribe YouTube videos into clean text, timestamped segments or SRT with language selection, manual/auto caption preference and optional translation. Same premium capability as youtube-transcript, optimized for transcribe/transcription discovery queries.

youtube-transcript-api.description: YouTube Transcript API endpoint for AI agents and x402 clients. Get YouTube transcript, captions, subtitles, timestamps, SRT, language selection and optional translation with USDC payment on Base. Same premium capability as youtube-transcript, exposed under a high-intent API discovery alias.

youtube-captions.description: YouTube captions and subtitle extractor for AI agents. Get clean captions, subtitles or transcript from a YouTube URL or video ID with JSON, plain text or SRT-ready output, optional timestamps and language selection. Payment settles only after a successful response.

youtube-subtitles.description: YouTube subtitles API for AI agents. Extract subtitles, captions and transcript text from YouTube videos with timestamps, language selection and JSON/text/SRT output for LLM, RAG, research and automation workflows.

youtube-video-to-text.description: YouTube video-to-text API. Convert a YouTube video URL or video ID into clean transcript text with JSON, plain text or SRT-ready output. Low-cost endpoint for AI agents, RAG pipelines, research, indexing and automation.

video-transcript.description: Video transcript API optimized for YouTube and AI agents. Turn a YouTube video URL or video ID into clean timestamped transcript text, captions or SRT for LLM context, RAG ingestion, research, summarization and automation.

youtube-metadata.description: YouTube metadata API for AI agents. Resolve a YouTube URL or video ID into title, channel, canonical video URL and thumbnail metadata without API keys. Cheap preflight lookup before buying a transcript.

youtube-transcript-batch.description: Batch YouTube transcript API for AI agents. Extract clean transcripts from 2 or 3 YouTube videos in one paid request, with per-video success/failure results and optional language selection. Built for bulk transcript workflows, RAG ingestion, research, summarization, dataset creation and automation.

videos.description: Array of 2 or 3 YouTube URLs/video IDs.
